name: sunsteel
enchant_note: Steel that keeps the sun's fire holds a strong spell.
protection_note: Steel that keeps the sun's warmth (the plan's volcanic iron): fire is at home in it, frost is not.
protection_price: It turns brittle in the cold, and it conducts lightning.
lore_descriptor: golden and gives off a low, steady warmth
first_pickup_chronicle: Sunsteel, forged at high noon under a cloudless sky. The dead recoiled when I walked past. First time in my life I have been the scary one.
